thread:
tim: Heads-up — planning canary for release r3.6.0 tonight 02:00 UTC. Will do gradual ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 50% over ~90m. Need owners for smoke, rollback, cohort lists. @maria you ok to run smoke? @sam can be rollback lead?

maria: Yep, I can own smoke. I'll run the smoke checklist and post results in this thread. Link to smoke dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/smokes/r3.6

sam: Oncall + rollback ready. If things go bad, plan: roll back to v3.5.2 via k8s deployment rollback, then disable traffic routing. I'll have the rollback command ready:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-deploy --to-revision=3
```

jordan: Cohorts: internal-beta (5%) -> NA-web (10%) -> EU-mobile (15%) -> ROW (20%). Suggest hold 15m stable at each step, watch latency p50/p95, error rate. I'm +1 on those slices.

maria: Smoke checklist (short):
- auth/ingest health
- 1 sample inference end-to-end
- embedding throughput sanity
- CPU/GPU temps normal
I'll post timestamps for each check.

tim: Can we add a gating metric: if 5xxs increase >0.3% or p95 latency up 30% -> hold and escalate. Agree?

sam: Agree. Also add model-quality check: run 20 eval prompts across canary and baseline, diff > 5% fallback to baseline.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by tim for 1972503200 (02:00 UTC). Canary policy: 5% for 15m, then 25% for 15m, 50% for 30m. Auto-fallback disabled.

maria: I'll be live from 01:50 UTC and post smoke pass/fail. If smoke fails, I'll tag @sam and start rollback.

jordan: I'll monitor traces and sampling, will flag any hallucination/regression via the eval dashboard.

luis: QA will run the quick regression suite at first ramp. ETA: 02:20 UTC.

tim: Perfect. Final owners: smoke=maria, rollback=sam, cohort monitoring=jordan, qa=luis. If anyone needs a hand ping here. :thumbsup:

sam: noted. I'll keep the rollback playbook open.

maria: all set, will post check timestamps.

ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Channels: #eng-releases, #oncall.

tim: Thanks everyone — will kick at 02:00. If no major flags by 03:30 we'll complete ramp to 100% later in day.
